# 10 Small Creative Student API + Web UI Projects

## 1. **Quote of the Day with Mood Selector**
- **API**: Serves quotes filtered by mood/category (motivational, funny, sad)
- **UI**: Select mood → display quote with share buttons
- **Skills**: Filtering, data persistence, responsive design

## 2. **Personal Habit Tracker**
- **API**: POST/GET endpoints for daily habits, streaks, and stats
- **UI**: Add habits, check off completions, visualize streaks with charts
- **Skills**: Database design, Chart.js integration, CRUD operations

## 3. **Random Recipe Generator with Filters**
- **API**: Serve recipes based on cuisine, dietary restrictions, cook time
- **UI**: Filter options → display recipe cards with ingredients and instructions
- **Skills**: JSON parsing, conditional filtering, responsive grid layout

## 4. **Mini Expense Splitter**
- **API**: Calculate bill splits, track who owes whom, handle multiple currencies
- **UI**: Input expenses, assign people, generate settlement summary
- **Skills**: Math operations, user management, data visualization

## 5. **Study Session Pomodoro Timer with Stats**
- **API**: Log completed sessions, track daily/weekly productivity stats
- **UI**: Start timer, log breaks, view statistics dashboard
- **Skills**: Real-time updates, WebSockets (optional), data aggregation

## 6. **Movie/Book Rating Database**
- **API**: Add/search movies, rate them (1-5 stars), leave reviews
- **UI**: Search bar, display results, user ratings visualization
- **Skills**: Search functionality, ranking algorithms, user authentication basics

## 7. **Collaborative Playlist Creator**
- **API**: Create playlists, add songs, vote on songs (upvote/downvote)
- **UI**: Share playlist code, add songs, see real-time voting
- **Skills**: Collaborative features, sorting/ranking, real-time updates

## 8. **Random Workout Generator**
- **API**: Generate workouts by difficulty/duration/muscle group
- **UI**: Select filters, display workout routine, track completed exercises
- **Skills**: Randomization, filtering, timer functionality

## 9. **URL Shortener**
- **API**: Shorten URLs, track click counts, manage links
- **UI**: Paste URL → get shortened link, view analytics dashboard
- **Skills**: Data encoding, URL handling, basic analytics

## 10. **Anonymous Feedback/Confession Wall**
- **API**: POST anonymous messages, GET filtered/sorted messages
- **UI**: Submit feedback, display all messages in real-time, upvote favorites
- **Skills**: Anonymity handling, real-time updates, moderation basics

---

## Quick Tech Stack Suggestion for Any Project:
- **Backend**: Flask or FastAPI (Python)
- **Frontend**: HTML/CSS/JavaScript or Vue.js
- **Database**: SQLite (easy) or PostgreSQL
- **Hosting**: Heroku, Replit, or Railway (free tier)

**Which type interests you most?** I can give you starter code!
